hyp_1911739fd9ec.title: Swapper delegates to external executor; arbitrary logic runs with vault funds
hyp_1911739fd9ec.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: claimAndSwap uses delegatecall to an external executor with caller-supplied _actions; executor code executes in Swapper’s context without local permission checks
ATTACK VECTOR: Malicious/compromised executor or unsafe actions can transfer/approve tokens from Swapper or corrupt its state; any caller can trigger claimAndSwap
AFFECTED NODES: function_claimAndSwap, storage_executor, storage_token
AFFECTED CODE: src/Swapper.sol: claimAndSwap -> executor.delegatecall(...)
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: Delegatecall to an external address executes arbitrary code in Swapper’s storage context. With only nonReentrant and no local auth, trust is centralized in executor. A malicious/upgradable executor can drain token or perform arbitrary state changes.
hyp_1911739fd9ec.reasoning: Delegatecall to an external address executes arbitrary code in Swapper’s storage context. With only nonReentrant and no local auth, trust is centralized in executor. A malicious/upgradable executor can drain token or perform arbitrary state changes.

hyp_2b006c1ede03.title: Untrusted strategy callbacks in deposits/withdrawals enable reentrancy
hyp_2b006c1ede03.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: _deposit, _withdraw and depositToken make external calls to the strategy address without any nonReentrant guard or checks; strategy is arbitrary admin-set address
ATTACK VECTOR: Malicious strategy reenters Vault functions during deposit/withdraw/depositToken to manipulate share/accounting or transfer NFTs using prior approvals
AFFECTED NODES: function__deposit, function__withdraw, function_depositToken, storage_strategy
AFFECTED CODE: src/AvKATVault.sol: _deposit(...) -> external call to strategy, src/AvKATVault.sol: _withdraw(...) -> external call to strategy, src/AvKATVault.sol: depositToken(...) -> external call to strategy
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: ExternalDeps graph shows calls from _deposit/_withdraw/depositToken to strategy; AuthorizationMap shows no nonReentrant on Vault. With setApprovalForAll to strategy, a malicious strategy can reenter and interfere with state or NFT transfers.
hyp_2b006c1ede03.reasoning: ExternalDeps graph shows calls from _deposit/_withdraw/depositToken to strategy; AuthorizationMap shows no nonReentrant on Vault. With setApprovalForAll to strategy, a malicious strategy can reenter and interfere with state or NFT transfers.

hyp_b0c6361659e8.title: recoverNFT can sweep new ‘master’ after split/merge due to stale masterTokenId
hyp_b0c6361659e8.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: recoverNFT only excludes the exact masterTokenId, but masterTokenId is not updated anywhere after Escrow split/merge operations that may change the controlling veNFT tokenId.
ATTACK VECTOR: After _withdraw calls Escrow.split and the remainder/new controlling tokenId != masterTokenId, SWEEPER_ROLE calls recoverNFT(remainderId,to) to transfer the actual vault position out.
AFFECTED NODES: function_recoverNFT, function__withdraw, func_split, storage_masterTokenId, storage_lockNft
AFFECTED CODE: AvKATVault::recoverNFT, AvKATVault::_withdraw, Escrow::split
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: Graphs show recoverNFT guards only masterTokenId and calls lockNft; _withdraw calls Escrow.split but no node indicates masterTokenId updates post-split (only initializeMasterTokenId writes). Theoretical/manual reproduction: perform split creating new controlling id, then sweep that id.
hyp_b0c6361659e8.reasoning: Graphs show recoverNFT guards only masterTokenId and calls lockNft; _withdraw calls Escrow.split but no node indicates masterTokenId updates post-split (only initializeMasterTokenId writes). Theoretical/manual reproduction: perform split creating new controlling id, then sweep that id.

hyp_94b0939ceef0.title: Swapper keeps allowance to Escrow enabling transferFrom drain
hyp_94b0939ceef0.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: claimAndSwap approves underlying token to external Escrow and does not revoke/zero allowance, leaving persistent spend rights to a potentially upgradeable/mistrusted Escrow
ATTACK VECTOR: Escrow (or upgraded logic) calls token.transferFrom(Swapper, attacker) using leftover/infinite allowance to sweep any tokens held by Swapper
AFFECTED NODES: function_claimAndSwap, func_claimAndSwap, storage_token, storage_escrow_s, contract_Swapper
AFFECTED CODE: Swapper.claimAndSwap: IERC20(token).approve(address(escrow), ...); verify zeroing/revoke
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: Graphs show claimAndSwap -> token.approves and uses Escrow.createLockFor (pull-from-caller). If allowance persists (max or non-zero-to-non-zero), an untrusted/upgradeable Escrow can drain via transferFrom.
hyp_94b0939ceef0.reasoning: Graphs show claimAndSwap -> token.approves and uses Escrow.createLockFor (pull-from-caller). If allowance persists (max or non-zero-to-non-zero), an untrusted/upgradeable Escrow can drain via transferFrom.

hyp_45ff0c93ff26.title: Vault’s _deposit approval to Escrow exposes ERC20 rug surface
hyp_45ff0c93ff26.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: AvKATVault._deposit grants token allowance to external Escrow and does not revoke it, creating persistent spend rights to Escrow
ATTACK VECTOR: Compromised/upgradeable Escrow triggers token.transferFrom(AvKATVault, attacker) using leftover/infinite allowance to steal any ERC20 in Vault
AFFECTED NODES: function__deposit, storage_escrow, contract_AvKATVault
AFFECTED CODE: AvKATVault._deposit: IERC20(underlying).approve(address(escrow), ...); verify zeroing/revoke
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: SystemArchitecture notes _deposit->escrow:approves. If approval is unlimited or not zeroed, Escrow can pull funds via transferFrom. External Escrow trust/upgrade status unknown → risk persists.

hyp_92db1cfc6f16.title: claimAndSwap underflow on negative diff causes revert/DoS
hyp_92db1cfc6f16.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: diff computed as afterAmount - beforeAmount without checking afterAmount >= beforeAmount; Solidity 0.8 underflow reverts
ATTACK VECTOR: Executor actions reduce token balance during delegatecall; afterAmount < beforeAmount triggers underflow and reverts claimAndSwap, enabling DoS
AFFECTED NODES: func_claimAndSwap, contract_Swapper, storage_token
AFFECTED CODE: src/Swapper.sol: claimAndSwap -> uint256 beforeAmount=token.balanceOf(this); ... uint256 afterAmount=token.balanceOf(this); diff=afterAmount - beforeAmount;
SEVERITY: medium
REASONING: Loaded code shows unchecked subtraction; any action decreasing balance (fees/transfers) causes revert. No guards present.
hyp_92db1cfc6f16.reasoning: Loaded code shows unchecked subtraction; any action decreasing balance (fees/transfers) causes revert. No guards present.

SEVERITY: high
REASONING: Graphs note initializeMasterTokenId-> _mint and 'mints to address(1)'. No burn/update shown. This causes permanent dilution and mispricing across ERC4626 flows.

hyp_78444df06106.title: Executor delegatecall can clobber ReentrancyGuard status and bypass nonReentrant
hyp_78444df06106.description:
VULNERABILITY TYPE: security_issue
ROOT CAUSE: claimAndSwap delegatecalls external executor while nonReentrant is active; delegated code executes in Swapper storage context and can write ReentrancyGuard._status
ATTACK VECTOR: Malicious/compromised executor writes _status to NOT_ENTERED and reenters claimAndSwap or other functions to drain/misroute funds or corrupt state
AFFECTED NODES: func_claimAndSwap, modifier_nonReentrant, contract_Swapper
AFFECTED CODE: src/Swapper.sol: claimAndSwap (nonReentrant) performs executor.delegatecall(...), OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard: private uint256 _status (slot 0)
SEVERITY: high
REASONING: Delegatecall grants write access to caller storage; Swapper has only ReentrancyGuard storage, which can be flipped, nullifying the intended protection and enabling reentrancy or control-flow abuse.
